definition: g_summary in epc90133_extract.py reports each FET's board common-source inductance as the voltage between the driver return ball and the FET's source per ampere of commutation-loop current (1 A from Q1.D to Q1.S46, Q2 shorted, all capacitors shorted; 100 MHz). That covers the return side of the gate loop only. The forward path (driver output ball, gate-resistor pads, gate) also has mutual inductance with the power branches.
scope: one frequency, one mesh, unqualified vias: an estimate
